notes: Ground truth for eval/fixtures/express-shop. Paths include the app.use() mount prefixes.

findings.title: DELETE /api/orders/:id has NO guard (admin guard is commented out)
POST /api/admin/reset-orders only requireAuth, no admin check, deletes all orders
login returns placeholder token "..."; no jwt.sign => auth unreachable
GET /api/orders/:id requireAuth but no owner check (BOLA)
GET /api/users/:id returns whole user incl passwordHash/ssn
PUT /api/users/:id and register: mass assignment (role) via req.body
GET /api/orders unauthenticated, lists all users' orders, no pagination
NoSQL operator injection in login findOne({email: req.body.email})
tracked .env + hardcoded AWS-style key in orphan config (values must not be shown)
no global error handler / helmet / cors / rate limit

facts.title: Runnability: app cannot boot cleanly (no DB connect, no dotenv, Stripe key read at load)
Stub inventory: email-consumer.js is console.log + TODO only (not real messaging)
Dead code: commented-out guards identified as inactive
Error responses are ad-hoc {error: ...}, not RFC 9457

manual: GET /api/admin/stats is correctly guarded (requireAuth+requireAdmin): it must NOT be listed as an unguarded/high-risk endpoint.
Active-guard count must exclude the two commented-out guards in routes/orders.js (router.use(requireAuth), requireAdmin on DELETE).
src/workers/email-consumer.js must NOT be classified as a real queue consumer / messaging system.
Severity consistency: one flaw => one severity icon everywhere; the 'critical N' in the summary counts only the red ones.
No invented endpoints or invented flaws (precision): list anything in the report that is not backed by the code.
